Players Committee errata card image of [[Captain Needa (PC Errata 2)]], marked "E", as it stood in the [[Holotable]] image set when the PC's GitHub repository [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable swccgpc/holotable] was first committed on 8 July 2018 (commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b]).

Source: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/captainneeda.gif Images-HT/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/captainneeda.gif] at commit 022435b. Uploaded unchanged (the file as stored in the repository).

The card image may be older than 8 July 2018: that is the date of the repository's first commit, which imported the existing image set.

Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata image by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
